method.cpp_compiler: MSVC 19.44.35229 x64, CMake Release /O2, matching SDK DLL defines
method.perf3_unit: printed iterations over 10 seconds divided by 10; not full-process wall throughput
method.perf3_warmup: unchanged upstream 1 second of accumulated function-body time
method.batches: exact timed body extracted from perf1/2, 100 warmup iterations then 1000 timed iterations, MAL loop and all in-eval GC included
method.scheduling: sequential processes, rotated/reversed implementation order between rounds; no other agent tests/builds during measurements
method.memory: Windows process peak private commit MiB; max of three samples; includes host startup; process cap 1024MiB
method.statistics: medians of 3 independent process samples; ranges preserved; no significance claim from tiny differences
method.source_size: decoded Unicode characters with CRLF normalized to LF; comments/blank lines included; runtime source only, excludes tests, generated C++, benchmark harness, SDK and libraries

adaptations.das: common benchmark entry preserves file mode; omits SDK heap_collect between REPL lines because native frames cannot be scanned; Lisp VM GC remains enabled. CLI --backend verifies main/eval/native_call/read_all/collect.
adaptations.peg: only the SDK blanket no_aot flags in peg.das and detail/colors.das are temporarily changed for C++ generation and immediately restored byte-for-byte. Parser uses bool markers for rules without AST nodes to avoid C++ void*/Syntax* generic specialization collision.
adaptations.root_fix: native apply fast return ran an enclosing defer before its marker was initialized; a separate lexical block fixes caller-root deletion. Nine regressions fail on old code and pass on fixed code.
adaptations.nim: unmodified upstream algorithm; equality proc annotated noSideEffect in a private copy for Nim 2.4 compiler compatibility; -d:release, --cc:vcc, upstream markAndSweep GC
adaptations.stdin: Python and JavaScript use Windows stdin-only adapters; no evaluator/reader/core changes; history is disabled; Java uses upstream --raw
